ISLAMIC RELIGIOUS EDUCATION — PREMIUM REVISION PAPER #4
====

GRADE: Grade 4
SUBJECT: ISLAMIC RELIGIOUS EDUCATION
TIME ALLOWED: 2 hours 30 minutes
TOTAL MARKS: 100
EXAM BODY: KPSEA

INSTRUCTIONS
----
1. Answer all questions.
2. For calculations, show formula → substitution → steps → final answer with units.
3. For multiple choice, choose the best option.
4. Check your work before submitting.

SECTION A — MULTIPLE CHOICE
----
1. Respect in religious education is shown by: (1 mark)
   A. Skipping all moral lessons
   B. Mocking other people’s beliefs
   C. Refusing to help a neighbour
   D. Listening to others and living values taught at home and school

2. Which response best shows understanding of Selected Surahs? (1 mark)
   A. Use Selected Surahs to insult classmates of other faiths.
   B. Apply the teaching of Selected Surahs with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.
   C. Ignore safety and kindness while discussing Selected Surahs.
   D. Say Selected Surahs has no place in daily life.

3. Which response best shows understanding of Wudhu? (1 mark)
   A. Apply the teaching of Wudhu with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.
   B. Use Wudhu to insult classmates of other faiths.
   C. Say Wudhu has no place in daily life.
   D. Ignore safety and kindness while discussing Wudhu.

   B. Destroy trees without planting
   C. Waste food daily
   D. Pollute rivers deliberately

   B. Ignore safety and kindness while discussing Attributes of Allah.
   C. Use Attributes of Allah to insult classmates of other faiths.
   D. Apply the teaching of Attributes of Allah with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.

   A. Say Prophets mentioned in the Qur’an Virtues of the Prophets (patience, honesty, tru has no place in daily life.

   D. Use Prophets mentioned in the Qur’an Virtues of the Prophets (patience, honesty, tru to insult classmates of other faiths.
